source_summary: Vertical Chinese landscape painting with misty mountains, small red-roofed buildings, layered groves, pines, rocky banks, and water passages; calligraphy, seals, and margins are excluded from motifs.

motifs.name: central_mountain_massif
motifs.description: Large dark mountain group rising in the upper middle-right, including the sheer central cliff, adjoining rounded summit on the right, diagonal ravines, lower rounded foothill, and mist-softened base.
must_preserve: dense ink-dot and hemp-fiber texture across the cliff faces
soft brown wash under the black texture
diagonal pale ravine cuts on the right-facing slope
rounded lower foothill with stippled crest
mist-blurred lower edges where the mountain dissolves into cloud

motifs.name: distant_left_peaks
motifs.description: Cluster of small distant conical mountains on the left horizon, partly submerged in mist below the main massif.
must_preserve: soft silhouettes of overlapping triangular peaks
graduated grey ink wash fading into surrounding mist
pale atmospheric gaps between peaks
minimal dry-brush texture on the slopes

motifs.name: mid_mountain_mist_band
motifs.description: Horizontal bands of pale mist and cloud wrapping around the base and sides of the mountains, separating distant peaks, central massif, and lower landscape.
must_preserve: irregular feathered mist edges
thin grey wash transitions
open pale reserves between dark mountains and trees
layered atmospheric depth without hard outlines

motifs.name: red_roof_village_cluster
motifs.description: Small low village or pavilion compound in the middle distance, with red-orange roofs and pale walls set at the foot of the mountains.
must_preserve: tiny red-orange roof accents
fine black roofline geometry and upturned eaves
pale wall shapes partially obscured by haze
surrounding low scrub strokes kept subordinate

motifs.name: midground_leafless_grove
motifs.description: Sparse midground grove of bare or lightly leafed trees across the right-center slope, including branching trunks, small shrubs, and a faint opening like a path or stream behind them.
must_preserve: thin angular branch linework
light brown trunk washes
small clustered leaf and shrub dots
transparent ink texture allowing misty ground to show through
irregular spacing between trees

motifs.name: foreground_pine_grove
motifs.description: Prominent foreground stand of tall pines occupying the lower left and center, with multiple vertical trunks and flattened needle clusters spreading horizontally.
must_preserve: reddish-brown textured trunks with dark contour lines
radiating pine-needle clusters in dark ink
layered horizontal boughs crossing between trunks
rooted rocky ground at the base
variation between dense dark needles and pale mist gaps

motifs.name: hidden_pavilion_under_trees
motifs.description: Small pavilion or house partly concealed at the lower left beneath dark foliage and pine trunks, including visible roof and railing-like wall details.
must_preserve: small pale architectural walls under the canopy
dark sloping roof edge partially hidden by foliage
fine railing or lattice linework
heavy surrounding ink wash of overhanging trees
sense of enclosure within the foreground grove

motifs.name: foreground_rocky_waterbank
motifs.description: Lower foreground rocky bank and water edge, including dark rocks, sloping earthen ledges, small stones, and a flat-topped pine-like tree near the water.
must_preserve: dark dry-brush rock masses along the bank
soft pale water or open ground reserves around rocks
flat horizontal foliage strokes of the small tree
brown wash on sloping ledges
scattered pebble accents and uneven shoreline contours

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
